scope: Readback of the saved radius-four fields and material placements at accepted update 6, plus its archived preparations. No new relaxation.
guarded_command: python3 scripts/s11c_guarded_run.py --pool r4_fold_order --memory-gib 8 --log-directory _scratch/s11c/r4_fold_order02 -- env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 /usr/bin/python3 -u software/stage1_solver/tools/mouth_r4_fold_order.py _scratch/s11c/r4_continuous_coarse01 _scratch/s11c/r4_fold_gate01/decision.json _scratch/s11c/r4_whole_mouth01 _scratch/s11c/r4_continuous_order01 _scratch/s11c/r4_whole_wider_order01/saved _scratch/s11c/r4_fold_order02/readout.json

field_conventions.coordinates: Shaft (x,a,t) = radial chart, polar angle radians, physical depth/L. Physical coordinates (r,z,theta) use the saved meridian and polar perturbation with a regular pole/axis quotient.
field_conventions.prism: The determinant extremizer is the native whole-cell extremizer. The six rational vertex positions use exact sums of saved binary labels and placements. The full triangle times angle maps into their axis-aligned box by convexity. Split the box at every Q1 field knot; every box extremum occurs at one of those tensor-product vertices. Evaluate there with exact rationals, and round bounds outward. A bound can also include spatial points outside the material prism.
field_conventions.terminal_from_fraction: For each threshold, the smallest t such that all cross-sections from t through the exit have chi <= threshold. At fixed depth a bilinear cell attains its bounds at radial/polar corners. Interpolate the final depth crossing of each such line on the depth mesh. Null means the criterion fails at the exit.
field_conventions.sample_counts: Distinct SHAFT SPATIAL field nodes count the axis once. Earlier narrow and wider fields use the overlay of native order and correction knots. These are node counts, not volume fractions.
field_conventions.correspondence: Selected_prism follows the same reference material vertex and element of the coarse lattice, allowing its physical position and the geometric minimum location to change with iteration.
field_conventions.collar: t=0.97765 is the common physical-depth fraction. The fine and coarse last free material rings have separate, directly measured landed depth fractions. At this depth the polar geometric perturbation vanishes. Shaft and exterior ranges include every angle and radial coordinate.
field_conventions.history: The absolute rest shaft seed reconstructs seed_order on the fine held shape. Its sharing receiver traces (shaft sidewall and exit disk) were prescribed at 0.5 in the prior receiver. The sole surviving held rest spatial update is 60; overwritten earlier updates retain scalar log data only. The driven held solution starts from converged rest order and its own earlier carrier. The wider-pinned solution is a comparison, not the rest seed. The coarse states are optimization updates, not sampled physical times.
field_conventions.axis_distance: Legacy raw column for spherical radius r; the perpendicular distance to the winding axis is r sin(theta).

saved_gate.early_stop_rule: After the first additional update: repeated fold at identical extremizer, minimum chart determinant <= 1e-13, and max shape force >= 0.99 of baseline. Recovery would require minimum chart determinant > 1e-10 and shape force < 0.9 of baseline. Otherwise inspect the second additional update.
